name: R4-D12
description: R4-D12 was an R4 astromech droid owned by the professional racer Marcus Speedstar. The droid assisted Speedstar in navigating his ship during races. In 34 ABY, the astromech took part in the Platform Classic, a major race held on the Colossus refueling station on Castilon that was ultimately won by Speedstar.
